source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 5 (PDF 95-116), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (States and Phases of Matter) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Matter exists in how many states?
(Maddah (matter) kitni haalaton (states) mein paya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maddah chaar haalaton mein hota hai: solid, liquid, gas aur plasma (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Matter exists in four states i.e., solid, liquid, gas and plasma.

blocks.prompt:
2 The simplest form of matter is the:
(Maddah ki sab se saada shakal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq maddah ki sab se saada shakal gas ki haalat hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: The simplest form of matter is the gaseous state

blocks.prompt:
3 Liquids are less common than the other states because the liquid state:
(Liquids baaqi haalaton se kam kyun paaye jaate hain?)

options.text: is ka koi muqarrara hajm (volume) nahi
is mein intermolecular forces sifar hain
sirf bohat zyada pressure par hoti hai
sirf temperature aur pressure ki tang hadd mein qaayam rehti hai

blocks.explanation: Liquid haalat sirf temperature aur pressure ki tang hadd (narrow range) mein qaayam reh sakti hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: the liquid state of any substance can exist only within a relatively narrow range of temperature and pressure

blocks.prompt:
4 The volume of a gas sample is equal to:
(Gas ka hajm (volume) kis ke barabar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas ki koi muqarrara shakal ya hajm nahi; gas ka hajm bartan (container) ka hajm hota hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: The volume of a gas is the volume of the container.

blocks.prompt:
5 Nearly what percentage of the volume of a gas is empty space?
(Gas ke hajm ka taqreeban kitna feesad khaali jagah hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas molecules door door hote hain; hajm ka taqreeban 99.9% khaali jagah hai, is liye gas aasani se dabti (compress) hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: most of the volume of the gas is empty space (nearly 99.9%)

blocks.prompt:
6 Cooling caused by the sudden expansion of a gas is called:
(Gas ke achanak phailne (sudden expansion) se thanda hona kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas ke achanak phailne se thanda hona Joule-Thomson effect kehlata hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: When sudden expansion of gases occurs cooling takes place. It is called Joule-Thomson effect.

blocks.prompt:
7 The pressure of a gas is due to:
(Gas ka pressure kis wajah se hota hai?)

options.text: molecules ka bartan ki deewaron se takraana
gas molecules ki aapas mein kashish
molecules ka apni jagah par thartharaana (vibration)

blocks.explanation: Gas ka pressure molecules ke bartan ki deewaron se takraane (collisions) se hota hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Pressure of a gas is due to the collisions of gas molecules with the walls of the container.

blocks.prompt:
8 According to the properties of gases, an ideal gas has:
(Gases ki khusoosiyaat ke mutabiq ideal gas mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: particles ka bara hajm aur mazboot forces
particles ka hajm sifar aur intermolecular forces na hone ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Ideal gas ke particles ka hajm sifar aur intermolecular forces na hone ke barabar hoti hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: There are negligible intermolecular forces in ideal gases.

blocks.prompt:
9 Gas laws describe the relationship of the volume of a given amount of gas with:
(Gas laws gas ki di gayi miqdaar ke hajm ka kis ke saath ta'alluq bayan karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gas laws gas ke hajm ka temperature aur pressure ke saath ta'alluq bayan karte hain (5.2).

book_ref.quote: The gas laws describe the relationships between volume of a given amount of gas

blocks.prompt:
10 According to Boyle's law, V ∝ 1/P when:
(Boyle's law ke mutabiq V ∝ 1/P kab hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Boyle's law: V ∝ 1/P jab n aur T qaayam (constant) hon (5.2).

book_ref.quote: According to Boyle’s law.

blocks.prompt:
11 Which relation is Charles' law?
(Charles' law kaun sa ta'alluq hai?)

options.text: V ∝ T, n aur P qaayam
V ∝ n, P aur T qaayam

blocks.explanation: Charles' law: V ∝ T jab n aur P qaayam hon (5.2).

book_ref.quote: According to Charles’ law

blocks.prompt:
12 Avogadro's law states that at constant temperature and pressure the volume of a gas is directly proportional to its:
(Avogadro's law ke mutabiq qaayam temperature aur pressure par gas ka hajm kis ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Avogadro's law: qaayam P aur T par V ∝ n (moles ki tadaad) (5.2).

book_ref.quote: According to Avogadro’s law volume of the given gas at constant temperature and pressure

blocks.prompt:
13 The value of the ideal gas constant R given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein ideal gas constant R ki qeemat kya di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas constant R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Its value is 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
14 The ideal gas equation is:
(Ideal gas equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Boyle, Charles aur Avogadro ke laws jod kar V = R nT/P, yani PV = nRT milti hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: The equation (4) is called the ideal gas equation.

blocks.prompt:
15 Combining the three gas laws when no variable is kept constant gives:
(Jab koi variable qaayam na rakha jaye to teeno gas laws mila kar kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: V ∝ 1/P, V ∝ T aur V ∝ n mil kar V ∝ nT/P bante hain (5.2).

book_ref.quote: If we think for a moment that none of the variables are to be kept constant

blocks.prompt:
16 How many moles of a gas occupy 8.21 dm³ at 2 atm and 400 K? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(2 atm aur 400 K par 8.21 dm³ mein gas ke kitne moles hon ge? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: The constant suggested is ‘R’ which is called Ideal gas constant.

blocks.prompt:
17 What volume is occupied by 2 mol of an ideal gas at 27 °C and 3 atm? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(27 °C aur 3 atm par ideal gas ke 2 mol kitna hajm gherein ge? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: It is a matter of common observation that when external conditions of temperature and pressure are changed

blocks.prompt:
18 0.25 mol of a gas is kept in a 5 dm³ vessel at 127 °C. Its pressure is: (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(0.25 mol gas 5 dm³ ke bartan mein 127 °C par hai. Is ka pressure kya hai? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: all the above three relationships can be joined together as:

blocks.prompt:
19 Putting n = m/M in the ideal gas equation gives:
(Ideal gas equation mein n = m/M rakhne se kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: n = m/M rakhne se PV = mRT/M (equation 5) milti hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Putting n = m/M in equation (4)

blocks.prompt:
20 The relative molecular mass of a gas is calculated from:
(Gas ka relative molecular mass kis formula se nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: PV = mRT/M ko tarteeb dene se Mᵣ = mRT/PV (equation 7) milta hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Equation (4) can be employed to calculate the relative molecular mass of a gas

blocks.prompt:
21 3.2 g of a gas occupies 2.46 dm³ at 27 °C and 1 atm. Its relative molecular mass is: (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(3.2 g gas 27 °C aur 1 atm par 2.46 dm³ gherti hai. Is ka relative molecular mass kya hai? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: At molecular level, the molar mass becomes relative molecular mass of a compound

blocks.prompt:
22 1.28 g of a gas occupies 0.448 dm³ at 0 °C and 1 atm. What is its molar mass? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(1.28 g gas 0 °C aur 1 atm par 0.448 dm³ gherti hai. Is ka molar mass kya hai? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: This is achieved by rearranging equation (4)

blocks.prompt:
23 In the equation PV = mRT/M, the symbol m stands for:
(PV = mRT/M mein m kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: m = gas ka mass grams mein, aur M = gas ka molar mass (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Where m = mass in g and M = molar mass of the gas

blocks.prompt:
24 0.88 g of a gas occupies 0.985 dm³ at 27 °C and 0.5 atm. Its relative molecular mass is closest to: (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(0.88 g gas 27 °C aur 0.5 atm par 0.985 dm³ gherti hai. Is ka relative molecular mass taqreeban kitna hai? (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: Determine the relative molecular mass of the gas.

blocks.prompt:
25 To use Mᵣ = mRT/PV with R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, a temperature of −23 °C must be written as:
(R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ke saath Mᵣ = mRT/PV istemal karte waqt −23 °C ko kaise likhein ge?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature kelvin mein chahiye: −23 + 273 = 250 K (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Solution: The molecular mass of the gas can be calculated by using the formula: M = mRT/PV

blocks.prompt:
26 Compared with gases, the rate of diffusion in liquids is:
(Gases ke muqable mein liquids mein diffusion (phailao) ki raftaar kaisi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquids bhi gases ki tarah diffuse hote hain magar bohat aahista (5.3).

book_ref.quote: the rate of diffusion in liquids is much lower than that in gases

blocks.prompt:
27 Liquids are about how many times less compressible than gases?
(Liquids gases se taqreeban kitne guna kam compressible (dabne wale) hain?)
blocks.explanation: Liquids gases se 10⁵ guna kam aur solids se taqreeban 10 guna zyada compressible hain (5.3).

book_ref.quote: Liquids are 10⁵ times less compressible than gases

blocks.prompt:
28 Compared with solids, liquids are:
(Solids ke muqable mein liquids kaise hain?)
blocks.explanation: Liquids solids se taqreeban 10 guna zyada compressible hain (5.3).

book_ref.quote: but about 10 times more compressible than solids

blocks.prompt:
29 Evidence for the free motion of liquid molecules is:
(Liquid molecules ki aazaad harkat (free motion) ka saboot kya hai?)

options.text: miscible liquids ka aapas mein diffusion

blocks.explanation: Miscible (aapas mein ghulne wale) liquids ka aapas mein diffuse hona molecules ki aazaad harkat ka saboot hai (5.3).

book_ref.quote: Diffusion among the miscible liquids is an evidence for the free motion of liquid molecules.

blocks.prompt:
30 There are little spaces among liquid molecules because:
(Liquid molecules ke darmiyan kam jagah kyun hoti hai?)

options.text: liquids mein kinetic energy nahi hoti
molecules crystal lattice mein tarteeb diye hote hain

blocks.explanation: Nisbatan mazboot intermolecular forces liquid molecules ko qareeb rakhti hain (5.3).

book_ref.quote: There are little spaces among liquid molecules because of relatively stronger intermolecular forces.

blocks.prompt:
31 On heating, the expansion of a liquid is:
(Garam karne par liquid ka phailao (expansion) kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Liquids garmi se phailte hain magar gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar (5.3).

book_ref.quote: However, this expansion is negligible compare to that in gases.

blocks.prompt:
32 According to kinetic molecular theory, a liquid changes into a solid when:
(Kinetic molecular theory ke mutabiq liquid kab solid banta hai?)

options.text: thanda karne se molecules ki kinetic energy kam ho
garam karne se kinetic energy barhe

blocks.explanation: Thanda karne se kinetic energy kam ho to liquid solid banta hai; garam karne se KE barhe to vapour (5.3).

book_ref.quote: a liquid is converted into a solid by decreasing its kinetic energy (on cooling)

blocks.prompt:
33 Which of the following is NOT one of the three intermolecular forces described for liquids?
(In mein se kaun si un teen intermolecular forces mein shamil NAHI jo liquids ke liye bayan ki gayin?)
blocks.explanation: Teen forces: id-id (London), permanent dipole-permanent dipole aur hydrogen bonding; metallic bonding in mein nahi (5.4).

book_ref.quote: Three types of such forces are mentioned here.

blocks.text: 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces)

blocks.prompt:
34 The momentary force of attraction between an instantaneous dipole and an induced dipole is called:
(Instantaneous dipole aur induced dipole ke darmiyan lamhati (momentary) kashish ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh lamhati kashish instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London dispersion) force hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The momentary force of attraction between an instantaneous dipole and an induced dipole

blocks.prompt:
35 Among the molecules of a non-polar compound, the intermolecular forces present are:
(Non-polar compound ke molecules ke darmiyan kaun si intermolecular forces hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Non-polar compounds ke molecules mein sirf instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London) forces hoti hain (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: These are only forces that exist among the molecules of non-polar compounds.

blocks.prompt:
36 London dispersion forces are stronger in larger molecules because:
(Baray molecules mein London forces zyada mazboot kyun hoti hain?)

options.text: un mein hydrogen bonds hote hain
woh mustaqil taur par zyada polar hain
un mein electrons kam hote hain
un ka electron cloud aasani se bikharta aur polarise hota hai

blocks.explanation: Baray atom ya molecule mein electron cloud aasani se bikhar aur polarise ho jata hai, is liye id-id forces mazboot hoti hain (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: in a larger atom or molecule the dispersion of electronic cloud and polarisation is relatively easier

blocks.prompt:
37 At room conditions, bromine is a:
(Aam halaat mein bromine kis haalat mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: F₂ aur Cl₂ gas, bromine liquid aur iodine solid hai; size aur polarizability barhne ki wajah se (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The first two members in the halogen family (F₂ and Cl₂) are gases

blocks.prompt:
38 According to Table 5.1, the boiling points of the noble gases:
(Table 5.1 ke mutabiq noble gases ke boiling points:)

options.text: He se Xe tak ghat'te hain
He se Xe tak barhte hain
He ka sab se zyada hai

blocks.explanation: Boiling points He (4.22 K) se Xe (165 K) tak barhte hain kyunke mass aur size barhta hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: This factor operates in the halogen and noble gas families.

blocks.prompt:
39 Using Table 5.1, the difference between the boiling points of I₂ (458 K) and Cl₂ (239 K) is:
(Table 5.1 se I₂ (458 K) aur Cl₂ (239 K) ke boiling points ka farq kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 458 − 239 = 219 K; bara I₂ molecule zyada mazboot London forces rakhta hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The physical state changes in the halogen family from top to bottom

blocks.prompt:
40 A molecule with a larger surface area has stronger intermolecular forces because it:
(Zyada surface area wale molecule ki forces mazboot kyun hoti hain?)

options.text: is ka molar mass kam hai
qareebi molecules se zyada raabte rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada surface area se qareebi molecules ke saath zyada raabte (contacts) hote hain, is liye forces mazboot (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: A molecule with larger surface area has more number of contacts for a nearby molecule.

blocks.prompt:
41 The boiling point of hexane (C₆H₁₄) is 68.7 °C and that of ethane (C₂H₆) is −88.6 °C. The difference is:
(Hexane (C₆H₁₄) ka boiling point 68.7 °C aur ethane (C₂H₆) ka −88.6 °C hai. Farq kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 68.7 − (−88.6) = 157.3 °C; hexane ki lambi chain mein kashish zyada hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Compare the length of the chains in C₂H₆ and C₆H₁₄.

blocks.prompt:
42 Among the isomers of pentane, the highest boiling point is shown by:
(Pentane ke isomers mein sab se zyada boiling point kis ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Seedhi chain wala n-pentane sab se zyada surface area aur sab se zyada boiling point rakhta hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Straight chain pentane has largest surface area and so is its boiling point among the three isomers of pentane.

blocks.prompt:
43 The weakest intermolecular forces among the pentane isomers occur in:
(Pentane isomers mein sab se kamzor forces kis mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neopentane ka surface area sab se kam, is liye forces sab se kamzor (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: the least strong forces occur in 2,2-Dimethylpropane

blocks.prompt:
44 According to Table 5.2, which hydrocarbon is a liquid at S.T.P.?
(Table 5.2 ke mutabiq S.T.P. par kaun sa hydrocarbon liquid hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methane se butane tak gases hain; pentane (b.p. 36.1 °C) liquid hai (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Boiling points of some hydrocarbons are given in Table 5.2.

blocks.prompt:
45 The three isomers of pentane differ in boiling point although they have the same Mᵣ because they differ in:
(Pentane ke teen isomers ka Mᵣ aik jaisa hai phir bhi boiling point mukhtalif kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mᵣ aik jaisa magar surface area mukhtalif, is liye London forces ki taaqat mukhtalif (5.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Three isomers of pentane have the same relative molecular mass

blocks.prompt:
46 The attraction between the positive end of one polar molecule and the negative end of a nearby polar molecule is a:
(Aik polar molecule ke positive sire aur qareebi polar molecule ke negative sire ki kashish kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh permanent dipole-permanent dipole force ki definition hai (5.4.2).

book_ref.quote: The force of attraction between the positive end of a polar molecule and the negative end of a nearby polar molecule

blocks.prompt:
47 Which pair of substances shows permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces as described in the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq kis jori mein permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces hain?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid HCl ke molecules aik line mein aa jaate hain; chloroform (CHCl₃) mein bhi yehi forces hain (5.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Whenever the HCl molecules are close to each other (as in liquid state)

blocks.prompt:
48 In a chloroform molecule the negative centre lies:
(Chloroform molecule mein negative markaz kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chloroform mein positive markaz H par aur negative markaz Cl atoms wale sire par hai (5.4.2).

book_ref.quote: The molecule of chloroform has a positive center at the H atom

blocks.prompt:
49 A hydrogen bond is a special type of:
(Hydrogen bond kis cheez ki khaas qisam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond dipole-dipole force ki khaas qisam hai (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bond is a special type of dipole-dipole force.

blocks.prompt:
50 Which statement about the hydrogen bond is correct?
(Hydrogen bond ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Yeh sab se mazboot intermolecular force hai magar ionic, metallic aur covalent bonds se kamzor
Yeh covalent bond se mazboot hai
Yeh sab se kamzor intermolecular force hai
Yeh ionic bond jitna mazboot hai

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond sab se mazboot intermolecular force hai magar ionic, metallic aur covalent bonds se kamzor (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: It is the strongest force among intermolecular forces

blocks.prompt:
51 The strength of a hydrogen bond is about:
(Hydrogen bond ki taaqat taqreeban kitni hai?)

options.text: aam covalent bond ka das-wan hissa

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond (dotted line se dikhaya jata hai) aam covalent bond ka das-wan hissa mazboot hai (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: its strength is one tenth of an ordinary covalent bond

blocks.prompt:
52 A hydrogen bond can form when hydrogen is bonded to:
(Hydrogen bond tab ban sakta hai jab hydrogen kis se jura ho?)

options.text: baghair lone pair wale C se
lone pair wale F, O ya N se

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen kisi bohat electronegative atom (F, O ya N) se jura ho jis par lone pair ho (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: The hydrogen atom is connected to a highly electronegative atom, such as F, O, or N

blocks.prompt:
53 On average, one water molecule can form how many hydrogen bonds according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq aik paani ka molecule ausatan kitne hydrogen bonds bana sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani mein do H atoms aur O par do lone pairs hain, is liye ausatan do hydrogen bonds (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and two lone pairs on oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
54 Ammonia forms only one hydrogen bond per molecule because:
(Ammonia har molecule aik hi hydrogen bond kyun banata hai?)

options.text: N par teen lone pairs hain
NH₃ mein sirf aik H atom hai
N par sirf aik lone pair hai

blocks.explanation: Teen H atoms ke bawajood N par sirf aik lone pair hai, is liye aik hi H-bond (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: ammonia can form only one hydrogen bond per molecule despite having three hydrogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
55 HF forms only one hydrogen bond per molecule because:
(HF har molecule aik hi hydrogen bond kyun banata hai?)

options.text: F par koi lone pair nahi
is mein sirf aik H atom hai
F par sirf aik lone pair hai

blocks.explanation: F par teen lone pairs hain magar HF mein sirf aik H atom, is liye aik hi bond (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: It has three lone pairs on the F atom which allows it to form three H-bonds.

blocks.prompt:
56 The boiling point of HF is higher than that of NH₃ because:
(HF ka boiling point NH₃ se zyada kyun hai?)

options.text: F ki zyada electronegativity ki wajah se HF ka hydrogen bond mazboot hai
HF mein zyada H atoms hain

blocks.explanation: F ki zyada electronegativity se HF ka H-bond NH₃ se mazboot hai: b.p. 19.9 °C bamuqabla −33.5 °C (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: Thus, its b.p (19.9℃) is much higher than ammonia (–33.5℃).

blocks.prompt:
57 In the solid state, HF molecules are joined by hydrogen bonds in a:
(Solid haalat mein HF molecules hydrogen bonds se kis tarah jurte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Solid HF ke molecules hydrogen bonds se zig-zag tarah jurte hain (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: The molecules of HF join with one other in a zig-zag manner in solid form

blocks.prompt:
58 The low acidic strength of HF compared with HCl, HBr and HI is due to:
(HCl, HBr aur HI ke muqable mein HF ki kam tezaabiyat (acidic strength) ki wajah kya hai?)

options.text: mazboot hydrogen bonding jo hydrogen ko phansa leti hai

blocks.explanation: Mazboot hydrogen bonding mein partial positive H do bohat electronegative F atoms ke darmiyan phans jata hai (5.4.3).

book_ref.quote: The exceptional low acidic strength of HF molecule as compared to HCl, HBr and HI

blocks.text: 5.4.4 Influence of hydrogen bonding on the properties of water

blocks.prompt:
59 Water has a high specific heat capacity because of its:
(Paani ki specific heat capacity zyada kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki khaas saakht mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hai, is liye specific heat capacity zyada hai (5.4.4).

book_ref.quote: Water has a high specific heat capacity.

blocks.prompt:
60 From H₂S to H₂Po the enthalpy change of vaporization:
(H₂S se H₂Po tak enthalpy change of vaporization kaise badalti hai?)

options.text: pehle gir kar phir tezi se barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Group 16 hydrides H₂S se H₂Po tak baqaida barhti hai, kyunke atomic size ke saath London forces barhti hain (5.4.4).

book_ref.quote: The general trend of enthalpy change of vaporization of group 16 hydrides is a regular increase from H₂S to H₂Po

blocks.prompt:
61 If water followed the trend of the other group 16 hydrides, its heat of vaporization would be:
(Agar paani baaqi group 16 hydrides ka trend follow karta to is ki heat of vaporization kaisi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se chhota hydride hone ki wajah se paani ki qeemat sab se kam hoti; hydrogen bonding se yeh sab se zyada hai (5.4.4).

book_ref.quote: If water had followed this trend, the heat of vaporization of water would be the lowest

blocks.prompt:
62 The high surface tension of water is due to the pull on surface molecules by:
(Paani ki zyada surface tension kis kheench (pull) ki wajah se hai?)

options.text: andar ke molecules, hydrogen bonds ke zariye
satah ke oopar hawa ke molecules

blocks.explanation: Neeche ki taraf kheench andar ke molecules ki hydrogen bonds ke zariye kashish se hai (5.4.4).

book_ref.quote: This downward pull is due to the attraction of inner molecules through hydrogen bonds.

blocks.prompt:
63 Water has a higher viscosity than hexane because:
(Paani ki viscosity hexane se zyada kyun hai?)

options.text: hexane ka molar mass zyada hai
hexane hydrogen bond nahi banata jab ke paani mazbooti se hydrogen bonded hai

blocks.explanation: Paani ki zyada viscosity mazboot hydrogen bonds se hai; hydrocarbons hydrogen bond nahi bana sakte (5.4.4).

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons lack the ability to make the hydrogen bond.

blocks.prompt:
64 In the tetrahedral structure of a water molecule, the two lone pairs of oxygen occupy:
(Paani ke tetrahedral structure mein oxygen ke do lone pairs kya gherte hain?)
